title: Cost and Provision of Subsidy for CCTV Installation in Preschools
what_it_is: Cost and Provision of Subsidy for CCTV Installation in Preschools

sections.label: CCTV cost and subsidy support
sections.summary: The passage asks whether the Ministry studied CCTV installation costs and can consider subsidy support for preschools, noting most had already installed CCTVs voluntarily.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development (a) whether the Ministry has conducted studies to determine the cost of CCTV installations in preschools; and (b) whether the Ministry can consider subsidy support to assist preschools in the mandatory installation of CCTVs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: These centres had done so voluntarily before ECDA announced last year in 2023 that CCTV would be mandatory by 1 July 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: In other words, the majority of preschools had already factored in CCTV installation as part of their business cost.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: For the remaining preschools that have yet to install CCTVs, operators should similarly build in this requirement into their business cost.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: The implementation can be costly for some operators in the tens of thousands of dollars for a single centre.

sections.label: ECDA CCTV implementation circular
sections.summary: ECDA issued an August circular requiring all preschools to implement CCTVs from 1 July, with over a year's lead time and an advisory approach until 31 December.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: ECDA then issued a circular with details of the implementation in August last year, stating that all preschools must implement CCTVs from 1 July this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: This includes details of CCTV camera requirements, locations of where CCTV cameras must be installed, recording and storage of CCTV camera footage as well as usage and access of CCTV footage by parents and authorities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: ECDA has provided lead time of over a year before the start of the mandate on 1 July this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: Additionally, I would like to inform the House that ECDA will also adopt an advisory approach for the first six months of implementation from 1 July this year to 31 December this year and enforcement will take place from 1 January 2025 onwards.
